## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth strong (8/11) and risk ratios mixed/flat with VXX showing decline but broader ratios SPY/TLT and HYG/LQD neutral; SPY RECOVERY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%), VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) ↓ falling.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stable-to-mixed: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) while LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.09%) → HYG/LQD mixed (neutral signal). Volatility easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) ↓ falling; Gold recovering: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Yields nudging higher: TLT CORRECTION (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) ↓ falling. Dollar mixed/relatively stable: UUP CORRECTION (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +2.09%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Sector rotation into Health/Financials: XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%); Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%). Style: rotation from Growth into cyclical/health names.

**5. US vs Global?**
US steady vs EM weakness: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) vs EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -6.72%); China mixed recovery: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -11.58%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact but selective: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +1.68%) and IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +4.03% | 1M: -8.36%) showing appetite; small caps mixed: IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.27%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals recovery: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%), SLV RECOVERY (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%); industrial metals mixed: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -8.15%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%); nat gas cooling but holding: UNG CORRECTION (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +0.96%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed pockets: XBI, XLV, XLF ABOVE TREND (all 1W & 1M positive). DIVERGENCE: MAJOR divergence across core ETFs — multiple CORRECTION signals (IWM, XLI, XLU, GOVT) where 1W ≠ 1M, suppressing a strong directional call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective cyclicals and health: XLF, XLV, XBI showing strength; reduce exposure to long-duration tech exposure: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%). Bonds neutral to watch given TLT CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND, XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND, USO (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -24.25%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/ XLF spread (monitor 1W momentum vs 1M trend) as growth→value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, risk ratios and credit measures largely flat. Healthcare and Biotech (XLV, XBI) and Financials (XLF) showing relative strength. Key risk is the cross-timeframe divergence across core ETFs (IWM, XLI, XLU showing CORRECTIONs) and persistent weakness in XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%).
